label: 腾讯广告 Tencent Ads
terms_note: Register as a developer (QQ account as the sole login credential), create an application — 私有应用 (own advertiser / agency accounts) or 第三方应用 (up to 20 each), debug in the sandbox, then apply for production interface permissions per scope. Rate limits: per-interface 接口频控 page in the developer console. Free.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (oauth/authorize → oauth/token → oauth/refresh_token; scopes ads_management, account_management, ads_insights, audience_management, user_actions)
sdks: developers.e.qq.com → 开发文档 › SDK (official SDKs listed in the docs navigation; languages not enumerated this pass)

official_mcp: https://developers.e.qq.com/mcp (official 腾讯营销 MCP — 快速投放 / 基础 MCP tools, MCP Key from the developer console)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (腾讯营销 Marketing API v3.0) Confidence: **high** — the official developer portal pages (quick start, interface list, MCP page) were read directly.
auth: 1. Register as a developer at developers.e.qq.com with a QQ account (the only login credential; enterprises should use a shared QQ).

2. Create an application: 私有应用 (your own advertiser / agency accounts) or 第三方应用 (serve other advertisers) — up to 20 each; debug in the sandbox, then apply for production permissions by scope (`ads_management`, `account_management`, `ads_insights`, `audience_management`, `user_actions`).

3. `GET oauth/authorize` (advertiser consent) → `oauth/token` (authorization_code) → `access_token` + `refresh_token`; `oauth/refresh_token` to renew; tokens ride as query parameters with `nonce` / `timestamp`.

mcp_sdk: Official **腾讯营销 MCP** (developers.e.qq.com/mcp): MCP Key from the console; 快速投放 MCP reduces 40+ parameters to 4 required; covers marketing units / creatives / reports.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: 应用 id (client_id) of your Tencent Marketing API application (developers.e.qq.com > 应用程序管理).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: 应用 secret (client_secret) of the same application.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: refresh_token from the one-time OAuth consent (oauth/authorize → GET https://api.e.qq.com/oauth/token?grant_type=authorization_code). The runtime mints 1-day access tokens with grant_type=refresh_token; the refresh token itself expires after refresh_token_expires_in (30 days) and must then be re-authorized.

config_fields.name: account_id
config_fields.help: 推广帐号 id (account_id) the token may operate; used by `me` and by update_budget / pause_resume (adgroups/update needs account_id). For agency tokens use the sub-account id to operate.

me.note: GET advertiser/get?account_id=…&fields=[…]&pagination_mode=PAGINATION_MODE_NORMAL&page=1&page_size=1 with the common access_token / timestamp (seconds) / nonce (32-char random) query parameters.

list_accounts.note: GET advertiser/get without account_id: for an agency (代理商) token this lists all sub-accounts ('如未传 account_id，则默认拉取该代理商下属所有子客信息'); a direct advertiser token must pass account_id, so use `me` instead. raw.daily_budget is in 分 (fen). Returns the first 100 accounts (list_accounts takes no page argument); total in `total`.

list_campaigns.note: Marketing API v3.0 has no campaign level: the 营销单元 (adgroup) carries the daily budget and on/off status, so campaigns here are adgroups (GET adgroups/get). status is configured_status (AD_STATUS_NORMAL / AD_STATUS_SUSPEND). The daily budget is in raw.daily_budget in 分 (fen, 1/100 CNY; 0 = unlimited), so `budget` is not mapped. `status` is not sent as a filter.

get_report.note: GET daily_reports/get?account_id&level=REPORT_LEVEL_ADGROUP&date_range={start_date,end_date}&group_by=[date,adgroup_id]&fields=[…] (JSON-encoded query values, as the official SDK sends them); campaign_id filters on adgroup_id. cost_fen is spend in 分 (fen, 1/100 CNY). Up to 1000 rows (first page).

update_budget.note: POST adgroups/update {account_id, adgroup_id, daily_budget}: daily_budget is given in CNY (元) and sent in 分 (×100); allowed 5,000–400,000,000 分 (50–4,000,000 元), 0 = unlimited, and it may not go below 1.5× today's spend plus frozen funds. This changes spend. `currency` is ignored (CNY).

pause_resume.note: POST adgroups/update {account_id, adgroup_id, configured_status} (pause → AD_STATUS_SUSPEND, resume → AD_STATUS_NORMAL). Resuming restarts spend.
